entry.en: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay in Seychelles.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda tu estancia en Seychelles.
entry.quote: If you’re visiting Seychelles, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

entry.en: You must apply and pay online for a travel authorisation to enter Seychelles, up to 30 days before you arrive.
entry.es: Debes solicitar y pagar en línea una autorización de viaje para entrar en Seychelles, hasta 30 días antes de llegar.
entry.quote: You must apply and pay for a travel authorisation online to enter Seychelles. You can apply up to 30 days before you arrive.

entry.en: Entry requirements include a valid return or onward ticket.
entry.es: Los requisitos de entrada incluyen un billete de vuelta o de continuación válido.
entry.quote: a valid return or onward ticket

entry.en: Entry requirements include proof of confirmed accommodation.
entry.es: Los requisitos de entrada incluyen un comprobante de alojamiento confirmado.

entry.en: On arrival you may need to show proof of travel insurance covering any potential health costs.
entry.es: A tu llegada puede que debas mostrar un seguro de viaje que cubra posibles gastos médicos.
entry.quote: When you arrive, you may need to show proof you have travel insurance and are covered for any potential health costs.

entry.en: Cash worth 50,000 Seychellois rupees or more taken into Seychelles must be declared when you apply for your travel authorisation.
entry.es: El efectivo por valor de 50.000 rupias seychellesas o más que lleves a Seychelles debe declararse al solicitar la autorización de viaje.
entry.quote: If you are taking cash with a value of 50,000 Seychellois rupees or more into Seychelles, declare this when you apply for your travel authorisation.

safety.en: Crime is generally non-violent, but bags can be snatched, cars and boats broken into, and people robbed while walking at night.
safety.es: El delito suele ser no violento, pero pueden robar bolsos, forzar coches y barcos o robar a quienes caminan de noche.
safety.quote: Crime is generally non-violent, but people can have their bags snatched, cars and boats broken into or be robbed while walking at night.

safety.en: Generally the west coast is unsafe for swimming during the north-west monsoon (around December to March) and the east coast during the south-east winds season (around May to September).
safety.es: En general la costa oeste es insegura para nadar durante el monzón del noroeste (de diciembre a marzo) y la este durante los vientos del sureste (de mayo a septiembre).
safety.quote: In general, the west coast is unsafe during the north-west monsoon (around December to March), and the east coast is unsafe during the south-east winds season (around May to September).

safety.en: Beau Vallon beach and some other beaches may have dangerous rip currents when the sea is rough.
safety.es: La popular playa de Beau Vallon y otras pueden tener corrientes de resaca peligrosas cuando el mar está agitado.
safety.quote: The popular Beau Vallon beach, and some other beaches, may have dangerous rip currents when the sea is rough.

safety.en: Seychelles has strict drug laws, with severe penalties that may include fines and prison sentences up to life imprisonment.
safety.es: Seychelles tiene leyes estrictas sobre drogas, con penas severas que pueden incluir multas y prisión de hasta cadena perpetua.
safety.quote: Seychelles has strict laws on drug use and smuggling. Penalties are severe and may include fines and prison sentences, up to life imprisonment.

safety.en: Mahé is mountainous, and roads are narrow and winding, often with sheer drops and hairpin bends.
safety.es: Mahé es montañosa y sus carreteras son estrechas y sinuosas, a menudo con precipicios y curvas cerradas.
safety.quote: Mahé is mountainous, and roads are narrow and winding, often with sheer drops and hairpin bends.

safety.en: Although there is no recent history of terrorism in Seychelles, attacks cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: Aunque no hay antecedentes recientes de terrorismo en Seychelles, no se pueden descartar atentados.
safety.quote: Although there is no recent history of terrorism in Seychelles, attacks cannot be ruled out.

health.en: As a tourist, you must pay for medical treatment.
health.es: Como turista, debes pagar el tratamiento médico.
health.quote: As a tourist, you must pay for medical treatment.

health.en: The main hospital is at Mont Fleuri in Victoria on Mahé.
health.es: El hospital principal está en Mont Fleuri, en Victoria, en Mahé.
health.quote: The main hospital is at Mont Fleuri in Victoria on Mahé

health.en: Chikungunya is a mosquito-borne disease that causes flu-like symptoms.
health.es: El chikungunya es una enfermedad transmitida por mosquitos que causa síntomas gripales.
health.quote: Chikungunya virus is a disease spread by mosquitoes, and causes flu-like symptoms.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink in most areas of Seychelles, but quality is variable in undeveloped areas.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable en la mayor parte de Seychelles, pero su calidad varía en zonas poco desarrolladas.
health.quote: Tap water is safe to drink in most areas of the Seychelles, but water quality is variable in undeveloped areas.

health.en: Limited medical services are available outside the capital, Victoria.
health.es: Fuera de la capital, Victoria, hay servicios médicos limitados.
health.quote: Limited medical services are available outside the capital city of Victoria.

health.en: Check that you have travel insurance appropriate for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: Comprueba que tienes un seguro de viaje adecuado para tratamiento local o evacuación médica inesperada.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

help.en: The emergency number in Seychelles is 999 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Seychelles es el 999 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: Call the Seychelles police on +248 428 8000 to report any incident.
help.es: Llama a la policía de Seychelles al +248 428 8000 para denunciar cualquier incidente.
help.quote: Call the Seychelles police on +248 428 8000 to report any incident.

getting_in.en: Seychelles International Airport (SEZ) is the only international gateway to Seychelles, near the capital Victoria.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional de Seychelles (SEZ) es la única puerta de entrada internacional, cerca de la capital, Victoria.
getting_in.quote: Seychelles International Airport (SEZ IATA). The only international gateway to the Seychelles near the national capital, Victoria.

getting_in.en: Air Seychelles, the flag carrier, flies from Cape Town, Abu Dhabi, Mumbai, Hong Kong, Paris, Dar es Salaam, Johannesburg, Mauritius and Antananarivo.
getting_in.es: Air Seychelles, la aerolínea de bandera, vuela desde Ciudad del Cabo, Abu Dabi, Bombay, Hong Kong, París, Dar es Salaam, Johannesburgo, Mauricio y Antananarivo.
getting_in.quote: Air Seychelles is the country's flag carrier and flies from Cape Town, Abu Dhabi, Mumbai, Hong Kong, Paris, Dar es Salaam, Johannesburg, Mauritius and Antananarivo.

getting_in.en: International service is also available from Addis Ababa, Nairobi, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Istanbul and Doha on Ethiopian, Kenya Airways, Emirates, Etihad, Turkish and Qatar.
getting_in.es: También hay vuelos internacionales desde Adís Abeba, Nairobi, Dubái, Abu Dabi, Estambul y Doha con Ethiopian, Kenya Airways, Emirates, Etihad, Turkish y Qatar.
getting_in.quote: International service is also available from Addis Ababa (Ethiopian Airlines), Nairobi (Kenya Airways), Dubai (Emirates), Abu Dhabi (Etihad), Istanbul (Turkish Airlines), Doha (Qatar Airways)

getting_around.en: Air Seychelles operates multiple daily flights between Mahe and Praslin.
getting_around.es: Air Seychelles opera varios vuelos diarios entre Mahé y Praslin.
getting_around.quote: Air Seychelles operates multiple daily flights between Mahe and Praslin.

getting_around.en: Cat Cocos catamaran ferries make several daily crossings between Mahe and Praslin, with a daily extension to La Digue.
getting_around.es: Los catamaranes de Cat Cocos hacen varias travesías diarias entre Mahé y Praslin, con una extensión diaria a La Digue.
getting_around.quote: Cat Cocos operates catamaran ferries that provide several daily crossings between Mahe and Praslin and a daily crossing extension to La Digue.

getting_around.en: As of February 2021, non-residents should budget SCR1,300 to SCR1,820 per person for a one-way Mahe to Praslin ferry ticket.
getting_around.es: En febrero de 2021, los no residentes debían calcular entre SCR1.300 y SCR1.820 por persona por un billete de ferry de ida de Mahé a Praslin.
getting_around.quote: Non-residents should budget between SCR1,300 and SCR1,820 per person (February 2021) for a one way ticket from Mahe to Praslin.

getting_around.en: Inter Island Ferry runs between Praslin and La Digue with 8 daily departures taking 15 minutes.
getting_around.es: Inter Island Ferry une Praslin y La Digue con 8 salidas diarias de 15 minutos.
getting_around.quote: Inter Island Ferry operate a route between Praslin and La Digue with 8 daily departures taking 15 min to cross.

getting_around.en: Driving in Seychelles is on the left side of the road.
getting_around.es: En Seychelles se conduce por la izquierda.
getting_around.quote: Driving in Seychelles is on the left side of the road.

getting_around.en: Most public buses do not operate after 8pm.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de los autobuses públicos no circula después de las 20:00.
getting_around.quote: Most public buses do not operate after 8pm.

money.en: The currency is the Seychellois rupee (SR or SRe, ISO code SCR).
money.es: La moneda es la rupia seychellesa (SR o SRe, código ISO SCR).
money.quote: The islands' currency is the Seychellois rupee, denoted by the symbol "SR" or "SRe" (ISO code: SCR).

money.en: ATMs usually have the best conversion rates, while airports and banks also exchange money.
money.es: Los cajeros suelen ofrecer los mejores tipos de cambio, y aeropuertos y bancos también cambian dinero.
money.quote: ATMs usually have the best conversion rates; however, airports and banks also exchange money.

money.en: There is no longer a black market in currency.
money.es: Ya no existe mercado negro de divisas.
money.quote: There is no longer a black market in currency.

money.en: Most service providers already include a 5-10% service charge, and tipping is not obligatory but extra change is greatly appreciated.
money.es: La mayoría de los proveedores ya incluye un cargo por servicio del 5-10 %; la propina no es obligatoria, pero se agradece.
money.quote: Most service providers already include a service charge of 5–10%. Tipping is not obligatory in the Seychelles; however, any extra change is greatly appreciated.

money.en: The coco-de-mer, a nut from trees native to Seychelles, requires an export licence.
money.es: El coco de mar, fruto de árboles autóctonos de Seychelles, requiere licencia de exportación.
money.quote: a nut from trees native to the islands in the Seychelles - but this requires an export licence.

etiquette.en: Topless sunbathing is uncommon, and nudism is not accepted and is likely to cause offence.
etiquette.es: Tomar el sol en topless es poco habitual y el nudismo no se acepta y probablemente ofenda.
etiquette.quote: Topless sunbathing is uncommon. Nudism is not accepted and is likely to cause offence.

etiquette.en: Visitors are asked to respect the environment and leave it clean for visitors to come.
etiquette.es: Se pide a los visitantes respetar el entorno y dejarlo limpio para quienes vengan después.
etiquette.quote: Do the effort of respecting it and leaving it clean for visitors to come.
